canonical_example.text: La policía llevó a cabo un operativo muy arriesgado.
canonical_example.translation: The police carried out a very dangerous operation.

canonical_example.text: Ya sé que esta es una operación arriesgada y que es importante seguir los procedimientos.

canonical_example.translation: Carla is a daring and enterprising woman.

canonical_example.text: A veces hay que ser arriesgado si quieres triunfar.

canonical_example.translation: The bucket is full of coffee beans.

canonical_example.translation: Ruben took a pail and a shovel and went to play in the sand.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuál es el cubo de dos? - Ocho.
canonical_example.translation: What's the cube of two? - Eight.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cómo se saca el volumen de un cubo?
canonical_example.translation: How do you calculate the volume of a cube?

canonical_example.translation: Tono gave me a bucketful of chocolates for my birthday.

canonical_example.translation: I bought a bucket of corn at the farmers market.

canonical_example.translation: You'll have to replace the hub since almost all the spokes were broken in the accident.

canonical_example.translation: The mill stopped working because there was hardly any water in the millpond.

canonical_example.text: Puedes subirte a la azotea mediante la escalera del cubo.
